strings.WILDCARD_MODE_DESC:
Prepare to embrace the unexpected in Wildcard Mode, where the power of chance shapes your destiny. Here, you'll be granted a random set of abilities from an array of classes, challenging you to craft the most formidable build possible from the hand you've been dealt.

At the outset, you'll roll four random spells from all classes, and you're free to reroll these starting spells at will. As you grow stronger and ascend in levels, starting at level 10, you'll gain a new random ability every two levels, continually reshaping your strategy and gameplay.

Remember, your powers may be random, but your talents are entirely in your control. Assign talent points to any class specialization of your choice, bringing your unique, ever-changing build to life. Plus, the Scrolls of Fortune you earn along your journey offer the chance to reroll abilities you're less fond of, refining your Wildcard build to perfection.

Dive into the unpredictable, exhilarating world of Wildcard Mode, where you have the chance to create a hero unlike any other. Will you rise to the challenge and master the power of chance? Only the roll of the dice will tell.
